scripts.setup: yarn install && yarn env:copy && yarn db:up && yarn db:migrate && yarn db:generate
scripts.build: yarn workspace backend build && yarn workspace frontend build
scripts.test: yarn workspace backend test && yarn workspace frontend test
scripts.lint: yarn workspace backend lint && yarn workspace frontend lint
scripts.lint:fix: yarn workspace backend lint:fix && yarn workspace frontend lint:fix
scripts.env:copy: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('.env')){fs.copyFileSync('.env.example','.env');console.log('.env created from .env.example')}else{console.log('.env already exists')}"
